name: income
title: Income
description: What was received over a window (default: the last twelve months): salary, dividends, interest, rent, refunds, rewards; and what the holdings are expected to pay. view=summary: per period. types: per period and type, with its share. transactions: the lines with payer and type. Gross as booked; net_income = income - reversals. The forward views take a window that may reach into the future (default: the months after this one; a lone from is its own span): projection (per month: received, expected, each type, withheld, and basis, what the expected part rests on; the view for how much is expected in a month or a year); calendar (each expected payment and each principal a maturity returns, dated); sources, portfolios, accounts, positions (received, expected, total, last_year and next_12m per entity; positions lists every holding). rates, maturing and shift set what the expected income assumes. Example: {view: "projection", from: "2026", to: "2026"}.

account.description: Keep rows whose account name, id or nickname contains this (case-insensitive).

currency.description: Output currency, e.g. USD or CHF. Default: the configured one.

filter.description: Conditions, all of which hold: ["value > 1000", "date >= 2025-07", "category not in Rent, Groceries"].

from.description: Window start; snaps to the unit's start.

level.description: Type vocabulary of the types view: detailed (default) or primary.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default: as many as fit).

maturing.description: Forward views: what a maturing principal earns: cash (its account's rate), idle (nothing) or roll (the same holding again). Default cash.

max_chars.description: Most characters the result may take (default 16000); the page ends at a row boundary and the last line says how to get the rest.

payer.description: transactions only: keep only rows whose payer contains this text.

period.description: Bucket size (default total; monthly on the forward views).

rates.description: Forward views: constant (today's rates) or forward (floating rates along the forward curve). Default constant.

search.description: Keep rows with this text in any cell.

shift.description: Forward views: parallel shift of the floating rates in basis points (default 0).

sort.description: Column to sort by; "-" for descending. "-value": the main money column, largest first whatever the sign.

source.description: Keep this source id only (e.g. "schwab"); a comma list keeps several.

symbol.description: calendar and positions: keep only rows whose symbol contains this text.

to.description: Window end; snaps to the unit's end. Default today unless the tool says otherwise.

type.description: Keep income types whose label or id contains this (e.g. "dividend", "salary").
